netlist:
ce_temp_85
Vcc supply 0 12
Vin in 0 DC 0 AC 1 SIN(0 1m 1k)
Cin in base 10u
Rtop supply base 100k
Rbottom base 0 22k
Rc supply out 2.2k
Re1 emitter bypass 100
Re2 bypass 0 900
Ce bypass 0 100u
Q1 out base emitter q
.model q NPN(IS=1e-15 BF=150 BR=3 VAF=100 VAR=30 IKF=50m RB=40 RC=2 RE=1 CJE=20p CJC=8p TF=400p TR=20n TNOM=40 EG=1.05 XTI=2.5 XTB=1.2)
.options reltol=1e-6 vntol=1e-9
.temp 85
.op
.control
set numdgt=15
set wr_singlescale
set wr_vecnames
run
let value0 = v(base)
let value1 = v(emitter)
let value2 = v(out)
wrdata reference.dat value0 value1 value2
quit
.endc
.end
